question: Who has been appointed as the “State Brand Ambassador” of Uttarakhand government in August 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rishabh Pant**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Uttarakhand CM Pushkar Singh Dhami on 11 August 2022 named cricketer Rishabh Pant as the brand ambassador of the state.
 
• Pant was born in Roorkee in Uttarakhand’s Haridwar district.
 
• He plays as a middle-order wicket-keeper-batter for the Indian cricket team.
 
• In IPL, he represents Delhi Capitals and is captain of the team.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Uttarakhand, a state in northern India crossed by the Himalayas, is known for its Hindu pilgrimage sites.
 
• Rishikesh, a major centre for yoga study, was made famous by the Beatles’ 1968 visit.
 
• The city hosts the evening Ganga Aarti, a spiritual gathering on the sacred Ganges River.
 
• The state's forested Jim Corbett National Park shelters Bengal tigers and other native wildlife. 
 
• Uttarakhand:
 
 
• Formation: 9 November 2000
 
• Governor: Gurmit Singh
 
• Chief Minister: Pushkar Singh Dhami
 
• Capital: Gairsain (summer), Dehradun (winter)
